metadata.title: Semantic Feature Group Outage Benchmark for Network Intrusion Detection
metadata.description: Research code and measured outputs comparing semantic feature-family loss with size-matched random column loss, with grouped resampling on official RT-IoT2022 and a chronological LYCOS-IDS2017 Tuesday case. No claim of MaskAug reproduction.

title: Model Dependent Sensitivity to Semantic Feature Group Outages in Network Intrusion Detection
description: Executed research code and metrics for model-dependent feature-family outage sensitivity, with twenty random draws per family, training-only information and correlation controls, and official corrected LYCOS Thursday temporal replication. Exploratory statistics, matching diagnostics and limitations are included. No archival DOI has yet been issued.
